versos.grego: Οἱ κύριοι, τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔχετε Κύριον ἐν οὐρανῷ.

controles.web: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
controles.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
controles.livre: Senhores, procedei de maneira justa e imparcial com os vossos servos, sabendo que também vós tendes um Senhor nos céus.

versos.grego: Τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτερεῖτε, γρηγοροῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ,

controles.web: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
controles.kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
controles.livre: Perseverai na oração, vigiando nela com gratidão.

versos.grego: προσευχόμενοι ἅμα καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου, λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ, δι’ ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι,

controles.web: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
controles.kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
controles.livre: Orai também ao mesmo tempo por nós, para que Deus nos abra uma porta para a palavra, para que falemos do mistério de Cristo, mistério pelo qual estou preso.

versos.grego: ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

controles.web: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
controles.kjv: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
controles.livre: Para que eu o anuncie claramente,  como devo falar.

versos.grego: Ἐν σοφίᾳ περιπατεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω, τὸν καιρὸν ἐξαγοραζόμενοι.

controles.web: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
controles.kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
controles.livre: Convivei com sabedoria com os que estão de fora,  aproveitando o tempo oportuno.

versos.grego: ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι, ἅλατι ἠρτυμένος, εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ἀποκρίνεσθαι.

controles.web: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
controles.kjv: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
controles.livre: A vossa palavra seja sempre com graça,  temperada com sal, para que saibais como deveis responder a cada um.

versos.grego: Τὰ κατ’ ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
controles.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
controles.livre: Tíquico, irmão amado, fiel trabalhador e colaborador no Senhor, vos fará saber tudo o que vem acontecendo comigo.

versos.grego: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο, ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν,

controles.web: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
controles.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
controles.livre: Foi para isso que eu o enviei até vós, para que saibais como estamos,  e console os vossos corações.

versos.grego: σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ, ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν· πάντα ὑμῖν γνωρίσουσιν τὰ ὧδε.

controles.web: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
controles.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
controles.livre: Juntamente com ele está Onésimo, irmão fiel e amado, que é um de vós. Eles vos farão saber tudo o que está havendo por aqui.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἀρίσταρχος ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου, καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρνάβα, (περὶ οὗ ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς, ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς, δέξασθε αὐτόν,)

controles.web: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
controles.kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
controles.livre: Aristarco, que está preso comigo, vos saúda; e também Marcos, primo de Barnabé. Acerca dele, já recebestes ordens; se ele for até vós, recebei-o.

versos.grego: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος, οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν μοι παρηγορία.

controles.web: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
controles.kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
controles.livre: E também Jesus, chamado Justo. Dentre os circuncisos, esses são os únicos cooperadores meus no Reino de Deus, e têm sido consolação para mim.

versos.grego: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν, δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς, ἵνα σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
controles.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
controles.livre: Epafras, que é um de vós, servo de Cristo Jesus, vos saúda. Ele sempre luta por vós em orações, para que fiqueis íntegros e plenamente convictos em toda a vontade de Deus.

versos.grego: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει πολὺν πόνον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικίᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱεραπόλει.

controles.web: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
controles.kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
controles.livre: Pois dou testemunho dele de que ele tem trabalhado muito por vós, pelos que estão em Laodiceia, e pelos que estão em Hierápolis.

versos.grego: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ὁ ἰατρὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς καὶ Δημᾶς.

controles.web: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.
controles.kjv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
controles.livre: Lucas, o médico amado, vos saúda; e também Demas.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐν Λαοδικίᾳ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῆς ἐκκλησίαν.

controles.web: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.
controles.kjv: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
controles.livre: Saudai aos irmãos que estão em Laodiceia, e também a Ninfa, e à igreja que está na casa dela.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅταν ἀναγνωσθῇ παρ’ ὑμῖν ἡ ἐπιστολή, ποιήσατε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ Λαοδικέων ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀναγνωσθῇ, καὶ τὴν ἐκ Λαοδικίας ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀναγνῶτε.

controles.web: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
controles.kjv: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
controles.livre: E depois que esta carta for lida entre vós, fazei que ela também seja lida na igreja dos laodicenses, e que vós leiais também a de Laodiceia.

versos.grego: καὶ εἴπατε Ἀρχίππῳ Βλέπε τὴν διακονίαν ἣν παρέλαβες ἐν Κυρίῳ, ἵνα αὐτὴν πληροῖς.

controles.web: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
controles.kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
controles.livre: E dizei a Árquipo: Presta atenção ao trabalho que recebeste do Senhor, para que o cumpras.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου. μνημονεύετέ μου τῶν δεσμῶν. ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
controles.kjv: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.  Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.
controles.livre: Esta saudação é da minha mão, de Paulo. Lembrai-vos das minhas prisões. A graça esteja convosco.
